input.overview: Complete either drop bank to light successive Bonus X awards: first 2x, then 4x plus upper-rollover Extra Ball, then 6x, then a 10,000 ramp collect. Collect each lit award at its captive-ball lane, ramp, or upper rollover. Route 1 starts at the upper-left lane and finishes at the lower captive ball. Route 2 starts at the ramp and also finishes at the lower captive ball. Three consecutive ramp shots award one Extra Ball per ball.
input.simpleOverview: Complete either drop bank, then collect the lit Bonus X at the lower captive ball, ramp, upper captive ball, or lit upper rollover. Route 1 starts at the upper-left lane and ends at the lower captive ball; Route 2 starts at the ramp and ends there. Three consecutive ramp shots award one Extra Ball per ball.
input.summary: Use a drop bank to light the next Bonus X, then move to its collect. Start Route 1 at the upper-left lane or Route 2 at the ramp and finish at the lower captive ball. If the ramp is repeatable, three consecutive shots award Extra Ball.

quickInfo.name: Build Bonus X
quickInfo.summary: Either drop bank advances the 2x, 4x, and 6x ladder.

quickInfo.name: Start Route 1
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the upper-left lane, then finish at the lower captive ball.

quickInfo.name: Start Route 2
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the ramp, then finish at the lower captive ball.

quickInfo.name: Repeat the Ramp
quickInfo.summary: Three consecutive ramp shots award one Extra Ball per ball.

steps.text: Complete either drop bank once to light 2x Bonus, then collect it at the lower captive ball or ramp.
Complete a bank a second time to light 4x at the upper captive ball or ramp and Extra Ball at the lit upper rollover.
Complete a bank a third time to light 6x at the ramp or lit upper rollover; the fourth completion lights a 10,000 bonus collect at the ramp.
When the ramp return is safe, make three consecutive ramp shots for the once-per-ball Extra Ball.

alternatives.title: Run a route through the lower captive ball
alternatives.when: Use this when a route start is safer than repeating the drop banks.

steps.text: Start Route 1 at the upper-left lane, then shoot the lower captive ball; the first completion collects Bonus and the second awards Extra Ball.
Or start Route 2 at the ramp, then shoot the lower captive ball to collect Bonus.
Use the top-left targets, captive balls, and rollovers to light the L-O-R-T-I-U-M letters.
Complete the letters to light Special while continuing to convert lit Bonus X collects.

machineSetup: Confirm ball count and whether Extra Balls and Specials remain enabled or convert to points.
Test both drop banks, both captive balls, the ramp, upper-left lane, upper rollovers, center standups, and all L-O-R-T-I-U-M lamps.

playfieldReferences.label: Ramp
playfieldReferences.description: Route 2 start, several Bonus X collects, and the three-shot Extra Ball route.

playfieldReferences.label: Lower captive ball
playfieldReferences.description: Finish for both routes and a 2x Bonus collect.

cautions.issue: The ramp Extra Ball requires three consecutive ramp shots.
cautions.response: Do not interrupt the sequence with another scoring switch when pursuing that award.
